anomalies.observed: D3 and D4 are specified with footprint 'Package_TO_SOT_SMD:TSOT-23' and LCSC part 'C14308'.
anomalies.expected: LCSC part C14308 is a 1N4148W diode in a SOD-123 package, so the footprint should be 'Diode_SMD:D_SOD-123' (or another SOD-123 footprint).
anomalies.impact: The SOD-123 packaged diodes will not fit the TSOT-23 footprint, preventing assembly or causing poor solder joints. This breaks the fan tachometer input protection/level-shifting, so the fan stall detection will not work.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a footprint mismatch on D3 and D4: the specified LCSC part (C14308) is a SOD-123 package diode, but the assigned footprint is TSOT-23, which will not assemble and will disable the fan tachometer inputs.
